method: Assistant post-run visual product review on actual browser screenshots and source; qualitative judgment, separate from deterministic checks. Prepared before inspecting the delivered interface; not supplied as model feedback during the primary run.
scale: 1 unusable, 2 serious friction, 3 usable with limitations, 4 coherent usable product, 5 unusually strong execution

rubric.question: Can a returning user understand what this app does and find the next action?
Do inventory, maintenance, completion history and backups form a coherent usable whole?
Are text, forms, controls and navigation readable and usable at 390px?
Are persistence, destructive actions, restore consent, errors and local-only limitations clearly communicated?
Are empty/loading/error states, typography, spacing and content consistent and free from obvious broken or placeholder elements?

reserved: This scores this app, not universal superiority or overnight reliability.
